events.address: The Bowery Hotel, 335 Bowery, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A one-night NYFW beauty pop-up bringing the public together with Sephora Squad members, beauty editors and creators for personalized hair touch-ups, custom cocktails and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: The public RSVP experience advertises personalized hair touch-ups, custom cocktails and photo moments; no purchase requirement is stated in the verified listing.
events.caveats: Fashionista identifies this as open to the public with RSVP and links directly to the live Hair Haven RSVPify page. The registration page currently resolves, but its text is not exposed to this verifier, so no host-approval or capacity guarantee is inferred beyond the published RSVP requirement.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 5–8 PM at The Bowery Hotel. Use the direct Hair Haven RSVP page before traveling because the event begins this evening and capacity can change.

events.event_name: Reese’s × The Nitro Bar PB Whip Latte Pop-Up
events.address: Astor Place Plaza, 26 Astor Pl, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day Reese’s and The Nitro Bar pop-up debuting the limited-time Reese’s Pumpkins PB Whip Latte ahead of The Nitro Bar's planned NYC expansion.
events.what_is_free: Up to 1,000 Reese’s Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes are advertised each day, each with a recipe card and Reese’s Pumpkins; the first 100 people in line each day are also advertised to receive a limited-edition Reese’s × The Nitro Bar koozie, all while supplies last.
events.caveats: No RSVP requirement is published. Promotional drinks, candy, koozies and cooler surprises are finite and can run out before the listed end time. The official Hershey release confirms the NYC pop-up on September 14 and 15; current local listings place it at Astor Place beginning at 11 AM each day.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 and Tuesday, September 15 from 11 AM–5 PM at Astor Place Plaza in front of Chase Bank. Arrive early if the latte or first-100 koozie is the priority.

events.address: Columbia University campus, Broadway & W 116th St, New York, NY 10027
events.what_it_is: The Columbia stop of Goodnotes' East Coast campus café tour, with free coffee, a live DJ, photo booth and merch giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Goodnotes advertises free specialty coffee, a photo booth, live DJ and free merch; secondary event listings specify free coffee for the first 100 guests and an additional limited-edition gift while supplies last.
events.caveats: Goodnotes' official tour page confirms the Columbia stop on September 15 and directs visitors to RSVP. The 1–4 PM window and Broadway/W 116th Street campus location are corroborated by the current secondary event listing. Free items are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 1–4 PM at Columbia University around Broadway and West 116th Street. RSVP in advance through Goodnotes' tour page if available; arrive early for limited merchandise and free coffee.
